rationale: The trade is flat in P&L but the tape is constructive: SPEM has recovered most of its -1.52% gap, sits 94.5% up its daily range above VWAP ($51.88) and the 9-EMA ($52.00), and the last five 1m bars show rising volume (435→4035) pushing price up rather than fading. Flipping short here would fight an intraday recovery pattern, and closing forfeits a still-valid structure — invalidation at $51.84 is only ~0.4% below current price with the $52.42 target still offering ~0.7% upside, so holding with the original levels is the mechanically strongest choice.
